Trace, implement and test: Absolute Diff k

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int solve(int n, vector<int>&arr, int k)
{
    int sum1=0;
    int sum2=0;
    
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(i<k)sum1+=arr[i];
        if(n-i-1>k)sum2+=arr[n-i-1];
    }
    cout<<sum1<<" "<<sum2;
    
    return abs(sum1-sum2);
}

int main() {
    int n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vector<int>arr(n);
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++)cin>>arr[i];
    
    cout<<solve(n,arr,k);
    
    return 0;
}
